edit.description: Two helpers beside `one_clause_contract` (:1053), which b4545c82 already folded here — this entry folds the two compositions built on top of it. (1) `pub fn one_clause_findings(kind: &str, predicate: Predicate, features: &Features) -> Vec<Diagnostic>` — `engine::validate(&one_clause_contract(kind, predicate), std::slice::from_ref(features))`, the body both suites spell under a byte-identical doc comment. (2) `pub fn one_clause_admissibility(kind: &str, predicate: Predicate) -> Vec<Diagnostic>` — `engine::admissibility(&one_clause_contract(kind, predicate), &Locus::Document)`, documented as document-locus: all six call sites pass that locus and no other. `Diagnostic` and `Features` are already imported (:18, :24); `temper::engine`/`Locus` are not and come with the addition.

`findings` (:24) keeps its name and its 17 call sites — the kind is a per-file constant, so the wrapper stays and its body becomes a one-line delegation to `common::one_clause_findings("marketplace", predicate, features)`, the shape `scoped_rule` already has over `scoped_routing_rule`. The five inline `engine::admissibility(&common::one_clause_contract("marketplace", …), &Locus::Document)` spellings (:183, :260, :271, :291, :310) reach `common::one_clause_admissibility("marketplace", …)` instead. `use temper::engine::{self, Locus};` (:17) is then fully stranded — those six sites are its only uses — and goes; clippy runs at `-D warnings`. `Diagnostic` (:15) stays: it is the surviving wrapper's return type.

The same two moves at kind `pack`: `findings` (:70) — the twin carrying the identical doc comment, five call sites — delegates to `common::one_clause_findings("pack", predicate, features)`, and the lone inline admissibility spelling (:213, over `&engine::Locus::Document`) reaches `common::one_clause_admissibility("pack", predicate)`. `use temper::engine;` (:19) is stranded by the pair — lines 71, 213 and 215 are its only uses — and goes with them.

summary: One job — the findings a one-clause contract yields — is spelled twice as a wrapper and six times inline across two suites; fold both onto tests/it/common.

tests.asserts: the four field-addressing properties — nested name path, `[*]` each-grain, the inadmissible spellings, the bare name — pass unchanged with both compositions read through the one home

acceptance: `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` green, with `rg 'engine::(validate|admissibility)\(' tests/it/field_addressing.rs tests/it/type_predicate.rs` empty — neither suite composes the one-clause judge itself.
